name: Sail Research
summary: Sail Research provides infrastructure designed to run long-horizon AI agents efficiently and reliably.
overview: Sail Research is building cloud infrastructure for AI agents that operate over long tasks rather than brief interactions. It announced $80 million of seed and Series A funding at a $450 million valuation in June 2026.

facts.label: Latest financing
facts.note: Sail Research emerged from stealth with $80 million in seed and Series A funding at a $450 million valuation.

bull_case: Long-running agents need reliable state, secure environments and cost control. Sail can become valuable infrastructure if those workloads move from demonstrations into production.
bear_case: Cloud and model providers can bundle competing capabilities, while long-horizon agents may take longer to prove reliable, economical customer value than financing suggests.
latest_round: June 2026 seed and Series A: $80M at a $450M valuation
directory_notes: Public financing and operating data remain limited.

intelligence.description: Infrastructure for long-horizon AI agents, persistent sandboxes, and efficient inference.
company: Sail Research provides infrastructure for long-horizon AI agents, including persistent environments and telemetry intended to let agents work over hours or days. The company argues that this workload needs different infrastructure than short, turn-by-turn model interactions.
In June 2026, Sail announced $80 million of seed and Series A funding at a $450 million valuation. Sequoia led the seed and Kleiner Perkins led the Series A.
intelligence.why_it_matters: The infrastructure required for agents that operate for hours or days differs from simple chat inference. Sail is an early private benchmark for whether persistent agent workloads develop into a distinct cloud category.

changed.text: Profile reviewed against available public information.

takeaways: Sail targets persistent environments, telemetry and efficient inference for long-horizon agents.
It announced $80M of seed and Series A funding at a $450M valuation in June 2026.
Customer deployment and infrastructure economics are the key next proof points.
